title: Behavioral New Keynesian Models: Learning versus Cognitive Discounting
title_zh: 行为新凯恩斯模型：学习与认知折扣之比较
title_primary: 行为新凯恩斯模型：学习与认知折扣之比较
title_secondary: Behavioral New Keynesian Models: Learning versus Cognitive Discounting
authors: GRETA MEGGIORINI, FABIO MILANI
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper estimates a New Keynesian model with new and old behavioral elements. Agents in the model exhibit cognitive discounting, or myopia: they discount variables far into the future at higher rates than typically implied in the benchmark model. We investigate the model under different expectational assumptions: rational expectations, subjective expectations with infinite‐horizon learning, and subjective expectations with Euler‐equation learning. Under rational expectations, the model necessitates of large, possibly unrealistically so, degrees of myopia. The same result persists under infinite‐horizon learning, given that agents are still remarkably far‐sighted. But, under Euler‐equation learning, the model can fit the data with only minimal estimated degrees of myopia. The results indicate that the empirical evidence for cognitive discounting may be sensitive to the modeling of expectations, and they highlight learning as a key behavioral feature to understand macro‐economic fluctuations.
abstract_zh: 本文估计了一个包含新旧行为要素的新凯恩斯模型。模型中的主体表现出认知贴现或短视：他们对遥远未来的变量进行贴现的比率高于基准模型中通常隐含的比率。我们在不同的预期假设下考察该模型：理性预期、具有无限期学习的 subjective expectations，以及具有欧拉方程学习的主观预期。在理性预期下，该模型需要很大程度的短视，甚至可能大到不现实的程度。在无限期学习下，同样的结果依然存在，因为主体仍然显著地具有远见。但在欧拉方程学习下，该模型仅需估计出极小的短视程度就能拟合数据。结果表明，认知贴现的经验证据可能对预期的建模方式敏感，并凸显了学习作为理解宏观经济波动的关键行为特征。

title: The industrial geography of Eurasia in the 20th century: Soviet planners meet Tsarist fundamentals
title_zh: 20世纪欧亚大陆的工业地理：苏联规划者与沙俄基础的相遇
title_primary: 20世纪欧亚大陆的工业地理：苏联规划者与沙俄基础的相遇
title_secondary: The industrial geography of Eurasia in the 20th century: Soviet planners meet Tsarist fundamentals
authors: Marvin Suesse, Iris Wohnsiedler
official: 官方在线 2026-09-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: How responsive is the location of economic activity to shocks? This paper uses a new data set on the location of factories in the Russian Empire (1890, 1908) and the Soviet Union (1989), supported by modern nightlight data, to explore the forces determining the spatial location of industrial production in Eurasia over the long twentieth century. Over this period, the region experienced a radical shift in its economic system from market to central planning and back again. Production was also subjected to various shocks, including war and the associated relocation of firms, forced population movement, and infrastructure investments. We assess to what extent these shocks changed the role of agglomeration effects, local labour inputs and market access in determining industry location. We find that shocks to labour fundamentals shifted the economy to new spatial equilibria. Nonetheless, the shifts were small in magnitude and these forces were not powerful enough to eradicate the path-dependent effects of Tsarist locations that were still evident in the industrial structure of the region even a century later. These results suggest the impact of even severe shocks to a spatial equilibrium to be modest at the aggregate level.
abstract_zh: 经济活动的区位对冲击的响应程度如何？本文利用关于俄罗斯帝国（1890年、1908年）和苏联（1989年）工厂区位的新数据集，并以现代夜间灯光数据为支撑，探讨在漫长的20世纪中决定欧亚大陆工业生产空间区位的力量。在此期间，该地区的经济体制经历了从市场到中央计划再回到市场的根本性转变。生产还受到各种冲击的影响，包括战争及相关的企业迁移、强制人口流动和基础设施投资。我们评估这些冲击在多大程度上改变了集聚效应、本地劳动投入和市场准入在决定产业区位中的作用。我们发现，对劳动基本面的冲击使经济转向新的空间均衡。尽管如此，这些转变幅度较小，且这些力量不足以消除沙皇时期区位的路径依赖效应——即使在一个世纪之后，这种效应在该地区的工业结构中仍然显而易见。这些结果表明，即使是对空间均衡的严重冲击，其总体层面的影响也是温和的。

title: Monetary Policy in the Euro Area, when Phillips Curves ... are Curves
title_zh: 欧元区货币政策：当菲利普斯曲线……仍是曲线时
title_primary: 欧元区货币政策：当菲利普斯曲线……仍是曲线时
title_secondary: Monetary Policy in the Euro Area, when Phillips Curves ... are Curves
authors: Guido Ascari, Alexandre Carrier, Emanuel Gasteiger, Alex Grimaud, Gauthier Vermandel 等
official: 官方在线 2025-07-24 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: we estimate and simulate the non-linear model. We then study the recent inflation surge and the implications of state-dependent prices and wages for monetary policy in the estimated non-linear model. Unlike conventional models, our framework does not primarily explain inflation dynamics by exogenous supply shocks. Instead, the impact of shocks on inflation depends on their timing, size, and the business cycle. Consequently, the inflation-output stabilization trade-off faced by monetary policy is state-dependent. For example, monetary policy is more effective in curbing inflation, and supply shocks have larger effects during periods of high inflation.
abstract_zh: 我们估计并模拟了非线性模型。随后，我们研究了近期通胀飙升现象，以及状态依赖的价格与工资对估计的非线性模型中货币政策的影响。与常规模型不同，我们的框架并非主要通过外生供给冲击来解释通胀动态。相反，冲击对通胀的影响取决于其发生时机、规模及商业周期状况。因此，货币政策面临的通胀-产出稳定权衡是状态依赖的。例如，在高通胀时期，货币政策在抑制通胀方面更为有效，且供给冲击的影响也更大。

title: Different Institutions, Different Finance: Evidence from Early Twentieth-Century China
title_zh: 不同制度，不同金融：来自二十世纪初中国的证据
title_primary: 不同制度，不同金融：来自二十世纪初中国的证据
title_secondary: Different Institutions, Different Finance: Evidence from Early Twentieth-Century China
authors: Wanda Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-09-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Institutional legacies are associated not only with the scale of finance but also with the organizational forms that emerge. Using prefecture-level data from early twentieth-century China, where indigenous money houses based on relational contracting coexisted with modern banks operating under codified law, we document that prefectures more deeply embedded in the imperial administrative system had more money houses and lower private borrowing costs, consistent with lower information and enforcement costs in relational finance. Treaty-port prefectures instead had more modern banks, with this concentration widening from 1910 to 1935. The analysis is descriptive and does not establish causality.
abstract_zh: 制度遗产不仅与金融规模相关，还与涌现出的组织形式相关联。利用二十世纪初中国府级数据，当时基于关系契约的本土钱庄与依据成文法运营的现代银行并存，我们发现，更深入融入帝国行政体系的府拥有更多钱庄，且私人借贷成本更低，这与关系金融中较低的信息和执行成本相符。相反，通商口岸府则拥有更多现代银行，且这一集中趋势在1910年至1935年间不断扩大。本分析为描述性研究，并未确立因果关系。

title: Competition, Procurement and Learning-By-Doing in the Space Launch Industry
title_zh: 太空发射行业中的竞争、采购与干中学
title_primary: 太空发射行业中的竞争、采购与干中学
title_secondary: Competition, Procurement and Learning-By-Doing in the Space Launch Industry
authors: Ruibing Su, Chenyu Yang, Andrew Sweeting, William Parker, Johannes Spinnewijn 等
official: 官方在线 2026-02-09 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We estimate a dynamic model of the U.S. space launch industry. The model allows past launches to improve rocket reliability and lower launch costs. It also allows the government to make forward-looking procurement choices. We use the model to analyze policy-relevant issues in the recent history of the industry: the 2006 United Launch Alliance "merger-to-monopoly" and the effects of efficiencies in the form of learning synergies; innovations, such as SpaceX's Falcon 9 and ULA's recent introduction of Vulcan Centaur; the costs and benefits of forward-looking procurements; and, the trade-offs between the advantages of centralized control and possible inefficiencies.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了一个美国太空发射行业的动态模型。该模型允许过去的发射活动提升火箭可靠性并降低发射成本，同时允许政府做出前瞻性的采购决策。我们利用此模型分析该行业近期历史中与政策相关的问题：2006年联合发射联盟的“垄断式合并”及其以学习协同效应形式带来的效率影响；创新，如SpaceX的猎鹰9号和ULA近期推出的火神半人马座；前瞻性采购的成本与收益；以及集中控制的优势与潜在低效之间的权衡。

title: The Isolation index and variations on relative exposure
title_zh: 隔离指数及其相对暴露度的变体

title_secondary: The Isolation index and variations on relative exposure
authors: Casilda Lasso de la Vega, Oscar Volij
official: 官方在线 2026-08-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We provide an axiomatic characterization of the segregation order represented by the Isolation index, which is increasingly used by economists to measure segregation and related concepts. We extend this result to a broad family of segregation orders that includes the Atkinson and Entropy orders.
abstract_zh: 我们给出了由隔离指数所代表的隔离顺序的公理化特征，该指数日益被经济学家用于衡量隔离及相关概念。我们将此结果推广至一个广泛的隔离顺序家族，其中包括阿特金森顺序和熵顺序。

title: The Returns to Viral Media: The Case of US Campaign Contributions,
title_zh: 病毒媒体的回报：美国竞选捐款的案例
title_primary: 病毒媒体的回报：美国竞选捐款的案例
title_secondary: The Returns to Viral Media: The Case of US Campaign Contributions,
authors: Johannes Böken, Mirko Draca, Nicola Mastrorocco, Arianna Ornaghi
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Social media has created new, highly competitive markets for attention. But to what extent does attention on social media generate tangible economic returns and how are these returns characterized? Using a daily dataset of Twitter activity and campaign contributions for US Members of Congress (2019-2020), we show that attention on Twitter, as measured by likes, increases small donations. However, the effect is highly skewed: only a few members benefit substantially, consistent with a winner-takes-all market. These results are confirmed using a geography-based causal design tracking donation patterns across counties, showing that the increase in donations from attention on Twitter comes disproportionately from high Twitter usage areas.
abstract_zh: 社交媒体催生了新的、竞争激烈的注意力市场。然而，社交媒体上的注意力在多大程度上能转化为切实的经济回报，这些回报又具有怎样的特征？利用美国国会议员（2019-2020年）的推特活动与竞选捐款的日度数据集，我们表明，推特上的注意力（以点赞量衡量）会增加小额捐款。然而，这种效应高度偏斜：仅有少数议员获得显著收益，这与赢家通吃的市场特征相符。这些结果通过一项基于地理的因果设计得到证实，该设计追踪了各县的捐款模式，显示推特注意力带来的捐款增长不成比例地来自高推特使用率地区。

title: Financial frictions across the production network and the transmission of monetary policy
title_zh: 生产网络中的金融摩擦与货币政策的传导
title_primary: 生产网络中的金融摩擦与货币政策的传导
title_secondary: Financial frictions across the production network and the transmission of monetary policy
authors: De Sanctis, Alessandro & Gebauer, Stefan & Holm-Hadulla, Fédéric & Sirani, Matteo
official: 官方在线 2026-01-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We show that monetary policy transmission is shaped not only by a sector’s own financial frictions but also by those prevailing in the broader production network. The latter, indirect frictions amplify the output and price effects of monetary policy and empirically dominate the direct ones. The amplification results from a downstream demand channel, as customers respond to tighter policy by purchasing fewer inputs. This is partly offset by an upstream cost channel, reflecting that suppliers raise prices to protect margins when financing costs rise. We inspect the mechanism in a multi-sector general equilibrium model with input-output linkages and working-capital constraints. JEL Classification: C32, C67, E31, E32, E52
abstract_zh: 我们证明，货币政策传导不仅受到部门自身金融摩擦的影响，还受到更广泛生产网络中普遍存在的摩擦的影响。后者，即间接摩擦，放大了货币政策对产出和价格的影响，并在实证上主导了直接摩擦。这种放大效应源于下游需求渠道，因为客户在应对更紧缩的政策时会减少购买投入品。这一效应部分被上游成本渠道所抵消，反映出当融资成本上升时，供应商会提高价格以保护利润空间。我们在一个包含投入产出关联和营运资本约束的多部门一般均衡模型中检验了这一机制。JEL分类：C32, C67, E31, E32, E52

title: Fertility and welfare under Demeny voting
title_zh: 德梅尼投票下的生育率与福利
title_primary: 德梅尼投票下的生育率与福利
title_secondary: Fertility and welfare under Demeny voting
authors: Daryna Grechyna, Rhema Vaithianathan
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper analyzes the welfare implications of children’s enfranchisement within a political economy framework that emphasizes the trade-offs in public policy when the electorate includes different age groups. We derive the political equilibrium under Markov strategies and compare welfare under standard suffrage and suffrage that includes children, for both PAYG and fully funded social security systems. The franchise that maximizes welfare across demographic groups depends on the fertility rate in the economy. Policies chosen when all demographic groups have voting rights are Pareto-improving compared to those chosen under the standard voting rights system, which excludes children from the electorate, when the fertility rate is low, and Pareto-reducing when the fertility rate is high. This result is driven by the surplus or shortage of funds available to finance pensions, depending on the ratio of workers to retirees in the economy. The model produces a negative association between tax revenues and fertility rates, as well as between public pension spending and the share of parents, consistent with OECD data. The counterfactual analysis based on the model calibrated to match the distribution of the number of children per household in OECD countries indicates that children’s enfranchisement would improve the welfare of all generations in most OECD countries.
abstract_zh: 本文在一个强调不同年龄群体选民构成对公共政策权衡影响的政治经济学框架内，分析了儿童选举权扩展的福利含义。我们在马尔可夫策略下推导出政治均衡，并比较了在现收现付制和完全基金制社会保障体系下，标准选举权与包含儿童选举权两种情形下的福利水平。最大化各人口群体福利的选举权范围取决于经济中的生育率。当所有人口群体均享有投票权时所选政策，相较于将儿童排除在选民之外的现行标准选举权制度下的政策，在生育率较低时具有帕累托改进性质，而在生育率较高时则呈帕累托恶化趋势。这一结果源于经济中劳动者与退休者比例所决定的养老金融资盈余或短缺。模型预测税收收入与生育率之间存在负相关关系，公共养老金支出与父母占比之间亦呈负相关，这与OECD数据一致。基于校准至OECD国家每户儿童数量分布的反事实分析表明，在大多数OECD国家，儿童选举权的扩展将改善所有世代的福利。

title: Pumps and Plates: Passthrough of International Fuel and Food Price Shocks to Domestic Markets
title_zh: 泵与盘：国际燃料与食品价格冲击对国内市场的传导
title_primary: 泵与盘：国际燃料与食品价格冲击对国内市场的传导
title_secondary: Pumps and Plates: Passthrough of International Fuel and Food Price Shocks to Domestic Markets
authors: Huy Nguyen & Celine Thevenot
official: 官方在线 2026-07-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Fuel and food constitute significant portions of consumer baskets, yet their prices are highly volatile. The renewed energy price shock in March 2026, driven by geopolitical disruptions and supply constraints, has highlighted the macroeconomic and distributional importance of how international price shocks transmit to domestic markets. Spikes in these prices can have major social, political, and economic implications. The conventional policy approach is to allow domestic retail prices to align with international prices while protecting the most vulnerable. However, many countries intervene in price settings to shield their domestic markets from global fluctuations. This paper provides a comprehensive assessment of the passthrough from global to domestic retail prices for four commodities: gasoline, diesel, wheat, and rice over the past two decades in many countries. We employ a dynamic model of local projections building on the work of Kpodar and Abdallah (2017). Our findings indicate that average passthrough is incomplete, with fuel exhibiting higher and faster passthrough than food. The extent of passthrough varies by period, region, and between commodity exporters and importers. We also examine asymmetric responses to global price shocks and find evidence of a ratchet effect: price increases are more likely to be passed through than decreases.
abstract_zh: 燃料和食品在消费者支出篮子中占据重要份额，但其价格波动剧烈。2026年3月，受地缘政治动荡和供应限制影响，新一轮能源价格冲击凸显了国际价格冲击如何传导至国内市场的宏观经济效应与分配效应。此类价格飙升可能产生重大的社会、政治和经济影响。传统政策路径是允许国内零售价格与国际价格接轨，同时保护最脆弱群体。然而，许多国家通过干预价格设定来隔离国内市场免受全球波动影响。本文对过去二十年间多个国家四种大宗商品（汽油、柴油、小麦和大米）从全球到国内零售价格的传导机制进行了全面评估。我们基于Kpodar和Abdallah（2017）的研究构建了局部投影动态模型。研究结果表明，平均传导效应不完全，其中燃料的传导速度和幅度均高于食品。传导程度因时期、区域以及大宗商品出口国与进口国之间的差异而有所不同。我们还考察了对全球价格冲击的非对称反应，并发现了棘轮效应的证据：价格上涨比下跌更易被传导。

title: The Ins & Outs of Chinese Monetary Policy Transmission
title_zh: 中国货币政策传导的来龙去脉
title_primary: 中国货币政策传导的来龙去脉
title_secondary: The Ins & Outs of Chinese Monetary Policy Transmission
authors: Miranda-Agrippino, Silvia, Nenova, Tsvetelina, Rey, Hélène
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Using a novel indicator for the People's Bank of China monetary policy stance, we estimate a policy rule that accounts for the dual nature of its price stability mandate-encompassing domestic inflation and the exchange rate-and for the evolution of its operational framework. The Ins: The domestic transmission follows textbook patterns, with exceptions due to the active management of the renminbi and the financial account. The Outs: International spillovers are powerful and affect commodity markets, global production and trade. The pass-through to foreign (US) prices is substantial. Financial spillovers are second-order, and mostly derivative from trade spillovers.
abstract_zh: 我们采用一种新颖的指标来衡量中国人民银行货币政策立场，据此估算了一项政策规则，该规则兼顾了其价格稳定任务的双重性质——涵盖国内通胀与汇率——以及其操作框架的演变。内部传导遵循教科书模式，但因人民币的积极管理和金融账户而存在例外。外部溢出效应显著，影响大宗商品市场、全球生产与贸易。对国外（美国）价格的传导效应显著。金融溢出效应为二阶性质，主要源自贸易溢出。

title: Retreating from Science: The Long-Run Effects of the 1970s U.S. Military Disinvestment from University Research
title_zh: 退出科学：1970年代美国军事从大学研究撤资的长期效应
title_primary: 退出科学：1970年代美国军事从大学研究撤资的长期效应
title_secondary: Retreating from Science: The Long-Run Effects of the 1970s U.S. Military Disinvestment from University Research
authors: Daniel P. Gross, Bhaven N. Sampat, Hansen Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Between 1945 and 1970, the U.S. Department of Defense was one of the country's largest funders of university research, and the most important in the physical sciences and engineering. Political pressures subsequently led to this funding declining nearly two-thirds by the mid-1970s and never fully recovering. We show that these cuts were felt across the U.S. research system, with ensuing declines in university scientists, PhD production, and research output. Early career scientists who were DoD-funded in 1970 were more likely than peers to leave universities, with many moving to industry. Though some became more likely to patent, in the aggregate, this appears to have reduced science-linked innovation in related technologies and compressed U.S. leadership in formerly DoD-driven fields. These effects extend to outcomes more closely related to military objectives: fewer PhDs entered the defense industrial base, and an initial increase in science-linked defense patenting in the most exposed technology areas gave way to a long-run decline.
abstract_zh: 1945年至1970年间，美国国防部曾是全美高校研究最大的资助方之一，尤其在物理科学与工程领域占据主导地位。然而，政治压力导致该资助在1970年代中期锐减近三分之二，且此后从未完全恢复。研究表明，这一削减波及整个美国科研体系，引发高校科学家数量、博士培养规模及研究成果产出持续下滑。1970年受国防部资助的早期职业科学家比同龄人更易离开高校，其中多数转向工业界。尽管部分科学家专利申请倾向增强，但总体而言，这一转变削弱了相关技术领域的科学关联型创新，并压缩了美国在国防部主导领域的领先优势。这些影响延伸至与军事目标更直接相关的领域：进入国防工业基础的博士数量减少，且最初在受影响最严重的技术领域出现的科学关联型国防专利增长，最终演变为长期衰退。

title: The dismal theorem in a general equilibrium climate-economy model
title_zh: 一般均衡气候-经济模型中的悲观定理
title_primary: 一般均衡气候-经济模型中的悲观定理
title_secondary: The dismal theorem in a general equilibrium climate-economy model
authors: Christoph Hambel, Frederick van der Ploeg
official: 官方在线 2026-07-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We show that Weitzman (2009)’s dismal theorem resurfaces naturally within a dynamic asset pricing framework with temperature-related disaster risk. If the climate disaster loss distribution is sufficiently fat-tailed, the risk-adjusted expected loss term diverges. Under unit elasticity of intertemporal substitution (EIS), this causes the social cost of carbon (SCC) to explode and the underlying optimization problem to have no finite solution so that the dynamic general equilibrium analogue of the dismal theorem applies. We show that, if the risk of climate tipping increases with temperature, the fat tail becomes endogenous and the dismal result is more likely to be activated at higher temperatures.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，Weitzman（2009）的“ dismal theorem”在包含温度相关灾难风险的动态资产定价框架中会自然重现。若气候灾难损失分布具有足够厚的尾部，风险调整后的预期损失项将发散。在跨期替代弹性（EIS）为单位值时，这会导致碳的社会成本（SCC）激增，且底层优化问题无有限解，从而使得动态一般均衡版本的“ dismal theorem”成立。我们进一步表明，若气候临界点风险随温度升高而增加，厚尾特征将变为内生性，且该“ dismal”结果更可能在高温条件下被激活。

title: Price Setting and Volatility: Evidence from Oil Price Volatility Shocks
title_zh: 价格设定与波动性：来自油价波动冲击的证据
title_primary: 价格设定与波动性：来自油价波动冲击的证据
title_secondary: Price Setting and Volatility: Evidence from Oil Price Volatility Shocks
authors: Klepacz, Matthew
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Do changes in aggregate volatility alter the impulse response of output to monetary policy? I use plausibly exogenous oil price volatility shocks and exploit heterogene- ity in oil usage across industries to show that PPI item level price changes become less frequent and more disperse when volatility is high. This implies aggregate price flexibility does not increase when aggregate volatility is high. I construct a state- dependent pricing model with random menu costs to interpret the findings. Match- ing the new empirical facts, the model shows that increases in aggregate volatility do not substantially reduce monetary policy effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 总体波动性的变化是否会改变产出对货币政策的脉冲响应？本文利用外生性较强的石油价格波动冲击，并借助各行业石油使用量的异质性，发现当波动性较高时，生产者价格指数（PPI）分项价格变动频率降低且离散程度增大。这意味着总体波动性较高时，总体价格灵活性并未提升。为解释这一发现，本文构建了一个包含随机菜单成本的状态依存定价模型。在匹配新经验事实的基础上，该模型表明，总体波动性的上升并不会显著削弱货币政策的有效性。

title: Beyond Mean Exposure: How Exposure Variance Shapes Air Pollution Mortality Risk
title_zh: 超越均值暴露：暴露方差如何塑造空气污染死亡风险
title_primary: 超越均值暴露：暴露方差如何塑造空气污染死亡风险
title_secondary: Beyond Mean Exposure: How Exposure Variance Shapes Air Pollution Mortality Risk
authors: Bissan Ghaddar, Kimberly Singer Babiarz, Hongbin Li, Lingsheng Meng, Lynn Hildemann 等
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Ambient air pollution contributes substantially to premature mortality globally, and the effectiveness of policies addressing it depends critically on the shape of the dose-response relationship, which remains poorly understood. Linking hourly air pollution data with daily vital statistics from 251 Chinese cities over four years, we show this relationship depends not only on the mean, but also on the variance of within-period exposure. At a 7-day mean of 150 μg/m³, predicted mortality varies more across observed hourly PM2.5 distributions than across mean exposure differences of 100 μg/m³. The sign of this variance effect also depends on the mean: at low mean concentrations (a convex region), higher variance is associated with modestly higher mortality. At higher concentrations (a concave region), greater variance is associated with lower mortality – implying constant exposure is more harmful than fluctuating exposure for a given mean. These findings reveal important relationships masked using temporally aggregated air pollution data.
abstract_zh: 环境空气污染是全球过早死亡的重要诱因，而相关政策的有效性关键取决于剂量-反应关系的形态，但目前对此认知仍不充分。通过将中国251个城市四年的逐时空气污染数据与每日生命统计数据相关联，我们发现这种关系不仅取决于时段内暴露的均值，还取决于其方差。在7天均值为150 μg/m³的条件下，基于观测到的逐时PM2.5分布差异所预测的死亡率变化，甚至超过均值暴露差异达100 μg/m³时的影响。这种方差效应的方向也取决于均值：在低均值浓度（凸性区域）下，较高方差与死亡率适度上升相关；而在高浓度（凹性区域）下，较大方差则与死亡率下降相关——这意味着在给定均值条件下，持续暴露比波动暴露更具危害性。这些发现揭示了使用时间聚合空气污染数据时被掩盖的重要关联关系。

title: Oil supply shocks and inflation tail risks
title_zh: 石油供给冲击与通胀尾部风险
title_primary: 石油供给冲击与通胀尾部风险
title_secondary: Oil supply shocks and inflation tail risks
authors: Andrea De Polis, Álvaro Fernández-Gallardo, José Nicolás Rosas
official: 来源期次 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We analyze the asymmetric transmission of oil supply news shocks to the inflation distribution in the United States, the Euro Area, and the United Kingdom. Using quantile local projections and high-frequency identification, we document a stark asymmetry across these three large advanced economies: while median responses are transitory, the 90th quantile exhibits significant and persistent increases beyond one year. This upside tail sensitivity, consistent with state-dependent pricing, suggests that supply shocks are structural innovations to the skewness of the inflation distribution. Monetary policy should actively monitor such persistent inflation tail risks to keep expectations anchored.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了石油供给新闻冲击对美国、欧元区和英国通胀分布的不对称传导效应。利用分位数局部投影和高频识别方法，我们记录了这三个大型发达经济体之间显著的不对称性：尽管中位数响应是暂时的，但第90分位数表现出显著且持续超过一年的增长。这种上行尾部敏感性，与状态依赖定价相一致，表明供给冲击是通胀分布偏度的结构性创新。货币政策应积极监测此类持续的通胀尾部风险，以保持预期锚定。

title: The Growth of Surgical Robotic Technology
title_zh: 手术机器人技术的发展
title_primary: 手术机器人技术的发展
title_secondary: The Growth of Surgical Robotic Technology
authors: Albert N Link, Md Zubab Ibne Moid
official: 官方在线 2026-06-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: An understanding of the growth of surgical robotic technology is not only a contribution to the academic literature on the proliferation of new technology, but also it is a precursor to effective U.S. public policies toward this burgeoning new technology and possibly toward potential future standard-setting dimensions of an emerging ecosystem. Using patent application information from filings with the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office, we characterize the growth of this technology in terms of a traditional S-curve model. We also hypothesize a theory of the distribution of surgical robotic technology, and we test our theory empirically.
abstract_zh: 对手术机器人技术增长的理解，不仅是对新技术扩散学术文献的贡献，也是美国针对这一新兴技术制定有效公共政策，乃至可能为未来新兴生态系统标准设定维度奠定基础的前提。利用向美国专利商标局提交的专利申请信息，我们以传统的S曲线模型刻画了该技术的增长特征。我们还提出了一个关于手术机器人技术分布的理论假设，并对其进行了实证检验。

title: Artificial intelligence-driven forest fire land susceptibility mapping: A remote sensing and machine learning approach
title_zh: 基于人工智能的森林火灾土地易感性制图：遥感与机器学习方法
title_primary: 基于人工智能的森林火灾土地易感性制图：遥感与机器学习方法
title_secondary: Artificial intelligence-driven forest fire land susceptibility mapping: A remote sensing and machine learning approach
authors: Xulong Duan, Muhammad Haseeb, Zainab Tahir, Syed Amer Mahmood, Aqil Tariq
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Forest fires pose a significant threat to ecological stability, particularly in climatically vulnerable and topographically complex regions like Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. This study aims to identify the key environmental and anthropogenic drivers of fire occurrence in the Hazara Division and to evaluate the predictive performance of machine learning models for spatial susceptibility mapping. We hypothesize that climatic variability, vegetation conditions, and anthropogenic accessibility collectively influence forest fire distribution patterns, while elevation serves as an indirect spatial indicator of these environmental gradients. This research aims to comparatively evaluate the predictive performance of four machine learning classifiers: Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), XGBoost, and Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM) for forest fire susceptibility mapping. A dataset of 2100 georeferenced points (1050 fire and 1050 non-fire) was used, and 34 predictors were initially considered, compiled from four thematic domains: topographic (elevation, slope, landforms, etc.), vegetation based Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), Net Primary Productivity (NPP), Leaf area index (LAI), etc., climatic (Rainfall, Temperature maximum (Tmax), Temperature minimum (Tmin), Soil moisture (SM)), and anthropogenic (Distance to roads, settlements, waterways). After multicollinearity analysis using the Variance Inflation Factor (VIF < 5), 13 key predictors were retained. Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) analysis revealed that among the evaluated classifiers, RF achieved the highest predictive performance (AUC = 0.90), followed by SVM (AUC = 0.87), XGBoost (AUC = 0.86), and GBM (AUC = 0.85). RF and XGBoost demonstrated comparatively stronger responses to topographic and vegetation indices, while SVM showed a stronger response to climatic parameters. Across all models, elevation, anthropogenic factor, and temperature consistently ranked among the top predictors, validating the importance of terrain and human proximity. Spatial results indicate that lower-elevation peri-urban forest margins in southern Hazara exhibit higher susceptibility. While the modelling framework demonstrates strong predictive capability, uncertainties may arise from satellite-based fire detection accuracy and differences in spatial resolution among environmental predictors. The resulting susceptibility maps provide a practical decision-support tool for targeted mitigation and improved forest management planning.
abstract_zh: 森林火灾对生态稳定性构成重大威胁，尤其是在气候脆弱、地形复杂的地区，如巴基斯坦开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省。本研究旨在识别哈扎拉地区火灾发生的关键环境和人为驱动因素，并评估机器学习模型在空间敏感性制图中的预测性能。我们假设气候变异性、植被条件和人为可达性共同影响森林火灾的分布格局，而海拔作为这些环境梯度的间接空间指标。本研究旨在比较评估四种机器学习分类器——随机森林（RF）、支持向量机（SVM）、XGBoost和梯度提升机（GBM）——在森林火灾敏感性制图中的预测性能。研究使用了2100个地理参考点（1050个火灾点和1050个非火灾点）的数据集，初步考虑了34个预测因子，涵盖四个主题域：地形（海拔、坡度、地貌等）、基于归一化差异植被指数（NDVI）、净初级生产力（NPP）、叶面积指数（LAI）等的植被因子、气候因子（降雨量、最高温度（Tmax）、最低温度（Tmin）、土壤湿度（SM））以及人为因子（距道路、居民点、水道的距离）。经过使用方差膨胀因子（VIF < 5）进行的多重共线性分析后，保留了13个关键预测因子。受试者工作特征（ROC）分析显示，在所评估的分类器中，RF取得了最高的预测性能（AUC = 0.90），其次是SVM（AUC = 0.87）、XGBoost（AUC = 0.86）和GBM（AUC = 0.85）。RF和XGBoost对地形和植被指数表现出相对较强的响应，而SVM对气候参数表现出更强的响应。在所有模型中，海拔、人为因子和温度始终位列最重要的预测因子之列，验证了地形和人类邻近性的重要性。空间结果表明，哈扎拉南部低海拔城郊森林边缘区域表现出较高的敏感性。尽管该建模框架展现出较强的预测能力，但卫星火灾探测精度以及各环境预测因子间空间分辨率的差异可能带来不确定性。所生成的敏感性图为有针对性的减缓措施和改进的森林管理规划提供了实用的决策支持工具。

title: Individual strategy choice in the repeated Prisoner’s Dilemma
title_zh: 重复囚徒困境中的个体策略选择
title_primary: 重复囚徒困境中的个体策略选择
title_secondary: Individual strategy choice in the repeated Prisoner’s Dilemma
authors: Teresa Backhaus, Yves Breitmoser
official: 官方在线 2026-06-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Repeated interactions can sustain cooperation even when short-run incentives favor defection, but the individual strategies underlying such cooperation remain poorly understood. We study behavior in indefinitely repeated Prisoner’s Dilemma experiments and identify three robust behavioral types: defectors defectors, cautious cooperators, and strong cooperators. Both types of cooperators tend to continue cooperation after mutual cooperation, defect after mutual defection, and randomize after asymmetric outcomes, differing mainly in their initial willingness to cooperate. Variation in the strategic environment primarily changes the population shares of these types rather than their continuation behavior. These findings suggest that cooperation in repeated interactions is sustained by a small number of robust behavioral patterns. At the same time, the continuation behavior of cooperating types is largely insensitive to expected payoffs, contrary to standard game-theoretic predictions.
abstract_zh: 重复互动即使在短期激励倾向于背叛的情况下也能维持合作，但支撑这种合作的个体策略仍鲜为人知。我们研究了无限重复囚徒困境实验中的行为，并识别出三种稳健的行为类型：背叛者、谨慎合作者和强合作者。两类合作者在相互合作后倾向于继续合作，在相互背叛后选择背叛，在不对称结果后随机选择，主要区别在于初始合作意愿。战略环境的变化主要改变这些类型在总体中的占比，而非其后续行为。这些发现表明，重复互动中的合作由少数稳健的行为模式所维持。同时，合作类型的后续行为对预期收益基本不敏感，这与标准博弈论预测相悖。

title: Write incentives? Authors’ sentiment on generative AI
title_zh: 生成式人工智能对作者激励的影响：基于情感分析
title_primary: 生成式人工智能对作者激励的影响：基于情感分析
title_secondary: Write incentives? Authors’ sentiment on generative AI
authors: Shujie Liang, Paul Crosby, Jordi McKenzie
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Generative AI is reshaping the book industry, raising critical questions about intellectual property and fair compensation. While legal and general user perspectives have been widely examined, authors’ views remain under-explored. This study addresses that gap by examining whether authors are willing to allow their works to be used in AI training and what compensation they expect for existing and future works. Using survey data from members of the Australian Society of Authors, we apply Seemingly Unrelated Bivariate Probit and Seemingly Unrelated Regression models to identify key factors shaping these decisions. Results show that authors’ willingness to allow AI training is influenced by their fairness perceptions, prior beliefs about AI training, and patterns of AI use, while compensation expectations are primarily driven by concerns about replacement risk and income loss. These findings contribute new evidence to debates on AI, copyright, and creative labour markets.
abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能正在重塑图书产业，引发了关于知识产权和公平补偿的关键问题。尽管法律和普通用户的视角已被广泛研究，但作者的看法仍未得到充分探讨。本研究通过考察作者是否愿意允许其作品用于AI训练，以及他们对现有和未来作品期望获得何种补偿，来填补这一空白。利用澳大利亚作家协会成员的调查数据，我们应用似不相关双变量Probit模型和似不相关回归模型，识别影响这些决策的关键因素。结果显示，作者允许AI训练的意愿受其公平感知、对AI训练的既有信念以及AI使用模式的影响，而补偿期望则主要由对替代风险和收入损失的担忧驱动。这些发现为关于AI、版权和创意劳动力市场的辩论提供了新的证据。

title: The Economic and Ecological Impact of Soy in Brazil: A Synthetic Control Method Approach
title_zh: 巴西大豆的经济与生态影响：基于合成控制法的研究
title_primary: 巴西大豆的经济与生态影响：基于合成控制法的研究
title_secondary: The Economic and Ecological Impact of Soy in Brazil: A Synthetic Control Method Approach
authors: Stefano Ghinoi, Simone Piras, Luca Tasciotti, Valdemar João Wesz Junior
official: 官方在线 2026-06-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In recent decades, soy expansion in Brazil has generated significant environmental, social and economic impacts. However, there is no consensus about benefits and drawbacks, calling for a more careful account of the economic and ecological diversity of the territories where this phenomenon has been unfolding. By acknowledging this diversity, we investigate the economic and ecological impacts of soy by applying a synthetic control method to longitudinal data (1990–2019) at state level. We focus on three indicators (GDP, CO 2 emissions and deforestation) and explore how these indicators vary in five states (Goiás, Paraná, Piauí, Rio Grande do Sul, Tocantins). These states differ in terms of underlying conditions and timing of soy expansion but have in common a significant contribution of soy to their GDP. From an environmental perspective, the states where soy consolidated its presence during the period considered (Goiás and Paraná) experienced a general improvement compared to their synthetic counterfactuals, especially in terms of deforestation, while a pioneer state in soy production such as Rio Grande do Sul saw a worsening in environmental indicators, especially right after the 2008 global financial crisis. This is also reflected in the impact of soy on GDP, which has been negative in this state, suggesting that it may have suffered from being a plantation economy, with soy subtracting resources from potentially more beneficial sectors. This geographical and temporal heterogeneity indicates that the economic and environmental impact of soy cannot be reduced to a single dominant trend. The outcome depends on the trade‐offs with other sectors, which is in turn linked to the level of economic development of the state when soy took off.
abstract_zh: 近几十年来，巴西的大豆扩张对环境、社会和经济产生了显著影响。然而，关于其利弊尚未形成共识，这要求我们更细致地考量该现象所涉及区域的经济与生态多样性。基于这一多样性，我们采用合成控制法对1990-2019年州级面板数据进行分析，探究大豆种植的经济与生态影响。研究聚焦三项指标（GDP、二氧化碳排放量及森林砍伐率），并考察这些指标在五个州（戈亚斯州、巴拉那州、皮奥伊州、南里奥格兰德州、托坎廷斯州）的差异。这些州的基础条件与大豆扩张时间节点各不相同，但共同特征是大豆对其GDP贡献显著。从环境视角看，研究期内大豆产业已巩固的州（戈亚斯州与巴拉那州）相较于合成对照组呈现整体改善，尤其在森林砍伐方面表现突出；而作为大豆生产先驱的南里奥格兰德州，其环境指标却出现恶化，尤其在2008年全球金融危机后更为明显。这一趋势同样反映在大豆对GDP的影响上——该州大豆对GDP的贡献为负值，表明其可能陷入种植园经济困境，大豆产业挤占了更具发展潜力的其他部门资源。这种地理与时间维度的异质性表明，大豆的经济与环境影响不能简化为单一主导趋势。最终结果取决于大豆与其他部门间的权衡关系，而这种权衡又与大豆产业兴起时各州的经济发展水平密切相关。

title: Accounting for structural breaks in the Hamilton filter
title_zh: 汉密尔顿滤波中结构断点的处理
title_primary: 汉密尔顿滤波中结构断点的处理
title_secondary: Accounting for structural breaks in the Hamilton filter
authors: Luiggi Donayre, Eiji Goto
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper reveals that the regression-based trend-cycle decomposition of Hamilton (2018) introduces spurious cyclical dynamics when time series undergo structural breaks. Because the filter relies on an h -step ahead projection, trend adjustment mechanically lags behind regime shifts, inducing large and persistent biases in the cyclical component. We propose a parsimonious modification using a dummy-variable structure that allows the regression intercept and autoregressive components to adjust to identified breaks. Extensive Monte Carlo simulations show that this approach substantially reduces Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) across a wide range of data-generating processes. These gains are robust to variations in break magnitude, timing and number; sample size; and signal-to-noise ratio. Notably, our approach remains superior in pseudo-real-time settings, where the benefits from break-adjustment outweigh the costs of recursive break date estimation and revision. An empirical application to the Swiss franc/euro exchange rate demonstrates that our modification avoids the spurious cyclical spikes generated by standard filters during major policy shifts. Both ex-post and recursive real-time estimates confirm that our proposed framework provides a more reliable decomposition for macroeconomic assessment and inference.
abstract_zh: 本文揭示，当时间序列经历结构性突变时，基于回归的Hamilton（2018）趋势-周期分解会引入虚假的周期动态。由于该滤波器依赖于h步超前预测，趋势调整在机制转换后机械地滞后，导致周期成分出现大而持久的偏差。我们提出了一种简约的修正方法，利用虚拟变量结构，使回归截距和自回归成分能够适应已识别的突变。广泛的蒙特卡洛模拟表明，该方法在多种数据生成过程中显著降低了均方根误差（RMSE）。这些改进对突变幅度、时机和数量的变化，以及样本大小和信噪比均具有稳健性。值得注意的是，在伪实时环境中，我们的方法依然表现优越，因为突变调整带来的收益超过了递归突变日期估计和修正的成本。对瑞士法郎/欧元汇率的实证应用表明，我们的修正避免了标准滤波器在重大政策转变期间产生的虚假周期峰值。事后和递归实时估计均证实，我们提出的框架为宏观经济评估和推断提供了更可靠的分解。

title: Bank Capital and Misconduct Incentives
title_zh: 银行资本与不当行为激励
title_primary: 银行资本与不当行为激励
title_secondary: Bank Capital and Misconduct Incentives
authors: Jacob Seifert
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies large banks' incentives to engage in misconduct by abusing their dominant position in the market for loans and by mis-selling an add-on financial product to depositors. We draw new connections between stability-focused prudential regulation and misconduct by studying the impact of higher capital requirements on misconduct incentives. Higher capital requirements are more likely to increase misconduct incentives when incumbents enjoy a significant equity funding cost advantage over challenger banks. These results highlight the importance of regulatory coordination in the areas of bank conduct and financial stability.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了大型银行通过滥用其在贷款市场中的主导地位及向储户不当销售附加金融产品而从事不当行为的激励。我们通过考察更高资本要求对不当行为激励的影响，建立了以稳定性为核心的审慎监管与不当行为之间的新联系。当现有银行相对于挑战者银行享有显著的股权融资成本优势时，更高的资本要求更可能增加不当行为的激励。这些结果凸显了银行行为与金融稳定领域监管协调的重要性。

title: The Economics of Tariffs
title_zh: 关税经济学
title_primary: 关税经济学
title_secondary: The Economics of Tariffs
authors: Ralph Ossa, Stephen Redding
official: 官方在线 2026-02-26 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: A central insight from neoclassical economics is that international trade operates like an improvement in production technology. It generates mutual aggregate welfare gains for countries as a whole, but creates winners and losers within countries. Tariffs are a tax on this trading technology and distort the prices faced by domestic consumers and producers. Large countries can use tariffs to improve their terms of trade on world markets. But if all countries try to do so, they can end up with lower welfare than if they cooperated to liberalize trade. Tariffs can be used to redistribute income between the winners and losers from trade within countries. But there can be other more efficient ways to achieve redistribution. Policies to promote economic activity in critical industries can be rationalized based on externalities or national security. But these arguments typically rationalize targeted policies towards those industries and tariffs can be dominated by other policy interventions. Empirical findings from the recent waves of U.S. tariffs suggest that most of the incidence of these tariffs has been borne by U.S. importers, wholesalers, retailers and consumers rather than by foreign exporters. These tariffs have led to a large-scale reorganization of U.S. supply chains away from China to third countries. Although this reorganization has substantially reduced China’s share of U.S. imports, the U.S. remains indirectly exposed to China through the imports of these third countries.
abstract_zh: 新古典经济学的核心观点认为，国际贸易如同生产技术的改进，能为各国整体带来相互的福利增益，但也会在国家内部产生赢家和输家。关税是对这种贸易技术征收的税收，会扭曲国内消费者和生产者面临的价格。大国可以利用关税改善其在世界市场上的贸易条件。但如果所有国家都试图这样做，最终可能比合作实现贸易自由化时的福利水平更低。关税可用于在国家内部贸易赢家和输家之间进行收入再分配，但可能存在其他更有效的再分配方式。基于外部性或国家安全理由，可以合理化对关键产业的经济活动促进政策，但这些论点通常支持对这些产业实施针对性政策，而关税可能被其他政策干预手段所取代。近期美国关税浪潮的实证结果表明，这些关税的负担主要由美国进口商、批发商、零售商和消费者承担，而非外国出口商。这些关税导致美国供应链大规模重组，从中国转向第三国。尽管这种重组大幅降低了中国在美国进口中的份额，但美国仍通过从这些第三国的进口间接暴露于中国的影响之下。

title: What Do Trade Allowances Look Like? Evidence from Actual Payments to a Big-Box Retailer
title_zh: 贸易补贴是什么样子？来自一家大型零售商实际支付的证据
title_primary: 贸易补贴是什么样子？来自一家大型零售商实际支付的证据
title_secondary: What Do Trade Allowances Look Like? Evidence from Actual Payments to a Big-Box Retailer
authors: Andrés Elberg, Carlos Noton
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2025-12-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We document key features of trade allowances—a major component of the contracts between large retailers and manufacturers—using a unique panel data set on allowance payments negotiated between two supermarket chains owned by a large retailer and its suppliers over a two-year period. We show that trade allowances are large in magnitude, are paid by the vast majority of suppliers, and vary substantially over categories and, especially, across suppliers within categories. We further study trade allowance behavior along key dimensions of the manufacturer–retailer relationship. First, we report important interdependencies between allowances paid by multicategory suppliers across different categories, suggesting that single-category analysis of manufacturer–retailer interactions may be misleading. Second, we show that dedicated private label manufacturers do pay allowances, and that dual branders (i.e., national brand manufacturers who in addition produce private labels) tend to pay lower allowances than fully national brand manufacturers. Third, we examine the relationship between allowance payments and price promotional activities and find that price and nonprice incentives tend to be treated as substitutes. Fourth, we document a positive relationship between allowance payments and prices, suggesting that trade allowances do not mitigate the double marginalization problem. Finally, the evidence suggests that both market power and efficiency aspects are at play in the explanation of trade allowances. This paper was accepted by Eric Anderson, marketing. Funding: This work was supported by the Institute for Research in Market Imperfections and Public Policy [Grant ICM IS130002] and Fondo Nacional de Desarrollo Científico y Tecnológico [Initiation Grant 11180301 and Regular Grant 1170029]. Supplemental Material: The online appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.00817 .
abstract_zh: 我们利用一个独特的面板数据集，记录了贸易折让——大型零售商与制造商之间合同的主要组成部分——的关键特征，该数据集涵盖了一家大型零售商旗下两家连锁超市与其供应商在两年期间协商的折让支付。我们发现，贸易折让规模巨大，绝大多数供应商都会支付，并且在不同品类之间，尤其是同一品类内不同供应商之间存在显著差异。我们进一步从制造商—零售商关系的关键维度研究贸易折让行为。首先，我们报告了多品类供应商在不同品类之间所支付折让的重要相互依赖性，这表明仅对制造商—零售商互动进行单一品类分析可能具有误导性。其次，我们表明，专门的自有品牌制造商确实会支付折让，而双重品牌商（即同时生产自有品牌的全国性品牌制造商）往往比纯粹的全国性品牌制造商支付更低的折让。第三，我们考察折让支付与价格促销活动之间的关系，发现价格激励与非价格激励往往被视为替代品。第四，我们记录了折让支付与价格之间的正向关系，表明贸易折让并未缓解双重边际化问题。最后，证据表明，市场力量与效率因素都在解释贸易折让时发挥作用。本文由市场营销领域的Eric Anderson接受。资助：本研究得到市场不完美与公共政策研究所[Grant ICM IS130002]以及国家科学技术发展基金[Initiation Grant 11180301 and Regular Grant 1170029]的资助。补充材料：在线附录和数据文件可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.00817获取。

title: Endogenous comparative advantage via symmetry‐breaking policy equilibrium
title_zh: 通过打破对称的政策均衡实现内生比较优势
title_primary: 通过打破对称的政策均衡实现内生比较优势
title_secondary: Endogenous comparative advantage via symmetry‐breaking policy equilibrium
authors: Nobuhito Suga, Akihiko Yanase, Makoto Tawada
official: 官方在线 2025-12-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In this study, we analyze a symmetric policy game in a two-country model in which domestic policy affects a Ricardian comparative advantage. Considering a two-good, one-factor set-up in which each country's government provides a productive public good, we show that ex ante identical countries under free trade always choose different levels of public goods in the Nash equilibrium – meaning symmetry-breaking always occurs. We also examine how our analysis is modified in the presence of trade costs and in a multi-good set-up. Moreover, we present a more elaborate model with input–output linkages and entry regulation in an upstream market as an application.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们分析了一个两国模型中的对称政策博弈，其中国内政策影响李嘉图比较优势。考虑一个两商品、单要素的框架，其中每个国家的政府提供生产性公共物品，我们证明，在自由贸易下，事前相同的国家在纳什均衡中总是选择不同水平的公共物品——即对称性破缺总是发生。我们还考察了贸易成本的存在以及多商品框架下我们的分析如何被修正。此外，我们提出了一个更精细的模型，包含投入产出关联和上游市场进入规制，作为应用。
